the miR-200 family is downregulated in BCSCs and that miR-200 downregulation is a common feature among normal stem cells and cancer stem cells.

understanding how microRNAs regulate breast cancer stem cell self-replication.
the molecular basis of stem cell regulation and the role of stem cells in cancer development.
the identification of the molecular mechanisms that regulate the self-renewal and differentiation of breast cancer stem cells.

the downregulation of the miR-200 family of microRNAs is a common feature of stem cells and that this microRNA family is an important regulator of the clonal expansion and self-renewal of normal and cancer stem cells.
